responsibility: Declares the main M2RTS runtime-system API, exporting program/module lifecycle entry points, initial/termination procedure registration, HALT and user-facing error routines, runtime LENGTH support, and the set of exception-raising helpers used by generated GNU Modula-2 code. It is the primary public header for runtime control, sitting above M2Dependent and RTExceptions rather than implementing storage, I/O, or string primitives.
same_name_distinction: This is the public header for the GM2RTS pair: it exposes lifecycle, HALT/error, LENGTH, and exception-raising APIs to generated code, while GM2RTS.cc contains the runtime state, procedure-chain management, delegation to M2Dependent, and concrete exception-raising behavior.
